units.title: Good grains: four pots to know

lessons.title: Fluffy white rice
learn: Cooking rice by the absorption method
Resting rice so every grain is separate

steps.text: Rinse the rice in a sieve under cold water
steps.detail: Rub the grains with your fingers and keep going until the water runs almost clear.
steps.tip: Rinsing washes off loose starch, which is what makes rice sticky and clumped.

steps.text: Put the rice, water and salt in a pan with a tight lid and bring to the boil

timer.doneness: until big bubbles break all over the surface

steps.text: Turn the heat right down, cover and let it cook
steps.detail: Use the lowest setting on your smallest burner.

timer.doneness: until the water has gone and little holes dot the surface

steps.tip: Don't lift the lid. The steam trapped inside does half the cooking.

steps.text: Take the pan off the heat and leave it covered

timer.doneness: until the grains are tender and dry, with no water left at the bottom

steps.text: Fluff the rice with a fork and serve
steps.tip: Cool any leftovers within an hour, keep them in the fridge and eat them within a day.

lessons.title: Lemon herb couscous
learn: Steeping couscous instead of boiling it
Seasoning a plain grain so it tastes of something
ingredients: 250 ml hot vegetable stock or water
A handful of parsley or mint, chopped

steps.text: Boil the kettle and make up 250 ml of hot stock
Stir the oil and a pinch of salt into the couscous, pour over the stock and cover the bowl with a plate

timer.doneness: until all the liquid has soaked in and the grains are soft

steps.text: Fluff it up with a fork
steps.detail: Rake through the whole bowl and break up any lumps.

steps.text: Stir in the lemon and herbs, then taste and add salt
steps.tip: Couscous drinks up seasoning, so it usually needs more salt and lemon than you expect.

lessons.title: Egg fried rice
learn: Keeping a wok hot enough to fry, not steam
ingredients: About 400 g cooked rice, cold from the fridge
2 spring onions, whites and greens sliced separately

steps.text: Break up the cold rice with your fingers so there are no clumps
steps.detail: Rice cooked the day before is drier, so it fries instead of turning mushy.
steps.tip: Only use rice that went into the fridge within an hour of cooking and is no more than a day old.

steps.text: Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over a high heat

timer.doneness: until the oil shimmers and moves easily around the pan

steps.text: Add the spring onion whites and the peas and stir-fry

timer.doneness: until the peas are bright green and hot

steps.text: Push everything to one side, pour in the eggs and scramble them

timer.doneness: until the egg is just set but still soft

steps.text: Tip in the rice and soy sauce and keep tossing

timer.doneness: until every grain is steaming hot and starting to crackle

steps.tip: Reheated rice has to be piping hot all the way through, so don't cut this short.

steps.text: Take it off the heat, stir in the sesame oil and spring onion greens and serve

lessons.title: Mushroom risotto
learn: Adding stock a ladle at a time for a creamy risotto
ingredients: 150 g risotto rice, such as arborio
1 tbsp olive oil and 30 g butter

steps.text: Pour the stock into a small pan and keep it hot on a low heat
steps.tip: Hot stock keeps the risotto at a simmer. Cold stock stops the cooking every time you add it.

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in the oil over a high heat, then scoop them out onto a plate

timer.doneness: until golden and any liquid they let out has cooked away

steps.text: Melt half the butter in the same pan and soften the onion over a medium heat

timer.doneness: until soft and see-through, not brown

steps.text: Add the garlic and the rice and stir to coat

timer.doneness: until the edges of the grains look glassy

steps.text: Add the stock one ladle at a time, stirring often
steps.detail: Add the next ladle when the last one has almost soaked in.

timer.doneness: until the rice is creamy and tender with a slight bite in the middle

steps.text: Off the heat, stir in the mushrooms, the rest of the butter and the parmesan, then cover

timer.doneness: until it settles into a loose ripple when you shake the pan

steps.tip: If it's stiff, loosen it with a splash of the hot stock.
